description: Add ONE TYPED relation (Other("<rel>") edge) between two existing node ids, with confidence + evidence_count + provenance. Both endpoints must have a live node (else isError).

evidence_count.description: audit counter: how many times this relation has been confirmed/contradicted (default 0; non-negative, fits u32, else -32602)

rel.description: the relation type, e.g. governs, refines, contradicts

name: knowledge.relate
